inspection_method: shallow git clone plus README workflow sections, Obsidian plugin config, template files, collection notes, cleanup workflows, and automation/plugin references

anchors.why: Documents daily notes, scheduled/forgotten todos, meeting notes, scratch/info/archive lifecycle, attachment cleanup, tag cleanup, and plugin setup.
Shows broad community plugin dependencies including Dataview, QuickAdd, Shell Commands, Templater, Calendar, Omnisearch, Excalidraw, and Kanban.
Contains Daily, Meeting, Scratch, Note, Person, and Board templates.
Separates work/personal, soon/later, scheduled, forgotten, and daily task surfaces.
Documents cleanup flows for unused attachments, untagged notes, unused notes, and lifecycle movement.

known_limits: The repository depends on powerful plugins and shell automation that should not become a VAKS default.
Personal workflow folders and emoji path conventions should not be copied into VAKS architecture.
Optional AI/Copilot/vector index settings must remain outside VAKS truth and review layers unless separately authorized.
